source.methodology: Prompt-free per-case structured-decision outcomes normalized by model-skyline/structured-decision-run@2; all model calls, fallback calls, latency, and declared cost belong to the exact routable offering. Benchmark methodology: The two acceptance environments shipped in cactus-needle 3.0.1: 32 smart-home and 32 media-player utterances with deterministic expected call lists. ModelSkyline disables the runtime's changing automatic date fact, applies the vendor validation filter, then performs exact unordered call-set scoring. This is a small vendor-authored calibration panel, not an independent benchmark or a state-verifying home-automation evaluation.
